name: ir-remote-tools
description: Browser-based IR remote code tools: IRDB lookup and IR format conversion on GitHub Pages

scripts.build: tsc && node scripts/build-index.mjs && node scripts/build-lirc-index.mjs && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.index: tsc && node scripts/write-version.mjs && node scripts/build-index.mjs && node scripts/build-lirc-index.mjs
scripts.serve: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory dist
